description.title: Description
description.description: Optional. Explicit delay description. Only used when userInput is blank.

isCritical.title: Is Critical
isCritical.description: Optional. Explicit critical flag. Only used when userInput is blank. The LLM detects this automatically when userInput is provided.

reasonCode.title: Delay Reason Code
reasonCode.description: Optional. Explicit Delay_Reason__c picklist value. Only used when userInput is blank. Values: "1, Plant not in agreed condition" | "2, Permit Not Available" | "3, Insufficient Capacity Available" | "4, Materials Not Available" | "5, Correct Tooling Unavailable" | "6, External Labour Not Available" | "7, Cranage Unavailable" | "8, Access Staging / Equipment Unavailable" | "9, Task Conflicts" | "10, Work Took Longer than Planned" | "11, Unscheduled Work" | "12, Inclement Weather" | "13, Higher priority work took Preference" | "14, Services not Available" | "16, Work Cancelled"

userInput.title: User Input
userInput.description: The user's raw natural-language description of the delay (e.g. "Crane is down, can't lift the vessel. Urgent."). When provided, the LLM generates the title, description, reason code, and critical flag automatically.

workOrderId.title: Work Order ID
workOrderId.description: Salesforce record ID of the Work Order experiencing the delay. Ask the user which work order they are working on if not already known.
